clinic.name: Maple Grove Community Health
banner.demoDetail: Do not enter real personal or health information.
banner.offline: You're offline. We'll keep your answers on this screen until you're back.
help.title: Help
help.body: Stuck or prefer to talk to someone? Call the front desk at {phone} (demo number). You can also finish at the clinic. Nothing you've entered is lost.
steps.label: Progress
steps.consent: Agree to how we use your information
steps.chat: Tell us why you're coming in
steps.details: Add your details (scan your ID or type)
start.title: Let's get you ready for your first visit
start.time: About 10 minutes. You can save and finish later.
start.ai: You'll chat with an AI assistant. It helps you fill this in. It doesn't diagnose, and our staff review everything before your visit.
start.adultError: This service is for adults. Please confirm you're 18 or older, or finish at the front desk.
start.person: Rather do this with a person?
account.title: Create your account
account.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. You can paste it or use a password manager.
account.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
consent.title: How we use your information
consent.photoHint: Optional. Saves typing. You can say no and type instead.
consent.decline: No thanks, I'll finish at the front desk
chat.title: Why you're coming in
chat.greeting: Hi, I'm an AI assistant helping you get ready for your visit. What's the main reason you'd like to see someone?
form.title: Tell us about your visit
form.reason: Why would you like to be seen?
form.reasonHint: In your own words. A few words is fine.
form.duration: How long has this been going on? (optional)
form.visitType: How would you like to be seen?
form.access: Anything that would make your visit easier? (optional)
form.accessHint: For example, an interpreter or step-free access.
form.reasonError: Tell us briefly why you'd like to be seen.
details.title: Scan your ID to skip typing
details.lead: We'll read your name, date of birth and address. You'll check them next.
details.tip1: Lay it flat on a dark surface, all 4 corners showing
details.tip2: Even light, no glare or shadows
details.fileNote: JPG, PNG or HEIC, up to 8 MB. The photo is read on our servers and discarded straight away.
details.noScan: ID scanning is off, so please type your details. You can turn scanning on below.
details.wrongType: That file isn't a JPG, PNG or HEIC photo. Please choose a photo of your ID.
details.tooBig: That photo is larger than 8 MB. Please choose a smaller one or type your details.
details.failedTitle: That photo was hard to read. That's okay.
details.failedBody: Your photo has been deleted. Type your details below, or try one more photo.
confirm.title: Check your details
confirm.lead: We read these from your photo. Fix anything that's wrong.
confirm.manualLead: Please type your details as they appear on your ID.
confirm.name: Full legal name
confirm.couldntRead: We couldn't read this. Please type it.
confirm.legend: Shaded fields came from your photo. White fields need you.
confirm.err.name: Enter your full name as it appears on your ID.
confirm.err.dob: Enter a real date of birth, for example 3 27 1988.
confirm.err.state: Enter the 2-letter state code, for example WI.
book.title: Pick a time
book.none: No open times that day. Try another day.
book.noneAtAll: There are no open times right now. Please call the front desk.
book.takenAlternatives: The closest open times are highlighted below.
done.title: You're booked
done.bring2: Your insurance card, if you have one
done.bring3: A list of medicines you take
done.aiNote: Prepared from your chat with the AI assistant. It's not a diagnosis. Staff review it before your visit.
done.photo: We never stored your ID photo.
privacy.title: Your information
privacy.consentOn: You've agreed to how we use your information (version {version}).
privacy.consentOff: You haven't agreed to the notice, so we aren't processing your information.
privacy.withdraw: Withdraw consent and delete my details
privacy.anthropicNote: Copies of chat messages already sent to Anthropic are kept by Anthropic for up to 30 days (up to 2 years if flagged) and aren't deleted by this.
privacy.confirmWithdraw: This deletes your details, answers and booking, and stops processing. You can agree again later.
privacy.confirmData: This deletes your details, answers and booking. Your account stays so you can start again.
privacy.confirmAccount: This deletes your account and everything in it. You'll need a new invite to come back.
privacy.doneBody: We've removed your details from our systems.
frontDesk.title: Finish at the front desk
frontDesk.body: That's fine. Bring your photo ID and insurance card, and our staff will help you sign up when you arrive. Questions? Call {phone} (demo number).
saved.title: Your progress is saved
saved.body: Sign in with the same email and password to pick up where you left off.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.staff: This step isn't working right now. You can finish at the front desk instead.
book.current: You're booked for {when}. Picking a new time replaces it.
